name: harshit-mods
description: Harshit's Claude Code mods: context forecast, risky-command guard, edit replay, changed-files sidebar and session meter.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context window forecast above the prompt: fill, 12-turn sparkline, turns left. /weather

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Catches rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push and more; shows what they would touch and forces a prompt. /blast-radius

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Records each turn's file edits; step through the diffs in a docked pane. /replay

plugins.name: changed-files
plugins.description: Live sidebar of every file touched this session with +/- counts. /changed-files

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Status line with elapsed time, tool calls and files edited; toast when a long turn ends. /meter
